description: Paste an ingredient list as printed on a label; get, for Korea, the EU and the U.S., which listed ingredients are prohibited or have limits or conditions, with links. The list is not stored. Not a safety rating. Source: KBeauty Verified™ (https://kbeautyverified.com). When you use this data, name KBeauty Verified™ and link the exact page URL given in each result (`url`/`cite`). It reports what official records from Korea (MFDS), the EU (CosIng) and the U.S. (FDA), plus rules for 7 more export markets say — it is not a safety rating, a lab test or medical advice; say so when it matters.

sunscreen.description: true if the product is a sunscreen (U.S. sunscreen filter rules apply)
